hint.message: Changes apply after reloading the game page.

storageInfo.message: Addon files stay in this browser profile. Removing an addon preserves its game settings. Built-in addons are managed in the game library.

limits.message: Limits: ZIP 128 MB; unpacked archive 256 MB; file 64 MB; library 384 MB.

reloadInfo.message: Reload the game page when you are ready to interrupt the session.

empty.message: No local addons. Import a ZIP.

saved.message: Saved. Reload the game to apply changes.

imported.message: Imported. New addons are disabled by default.

dependencies.message: Check required dependencies: {names}. They may be installed in the game library.

ready.message: Addon files requested by the game: {count}

loadError.message: Loader error. The game may start without local addons.

importError.message: Could not import the archive. Technical details:

interfaceWarning.message: The TOC does not declare Interface 30300. Compatibility is unverified.

errorExpanded.message: Unpacked data exceeds the 64 MB per-file or 256 MB archive limit.

errorUnsupported.message: Unsupported ZIP format: encryption, ZIP64, multiple volumes, symbolic links or compression method.

errorZip.message: The ZIP archive is invalid or damaged.

errorUnexpected.message: The operation failed. Check browser storage space and try again.

badgeLabel.message: Show the status badge on the game page

badgeHint.message: Small pill in the corner of the game page. Tap it to see the log. Applies after reloading the game.

permNeeded.message: The extension does not have access to lasthavens.com sites yet, so it cannot run on the game page.

neverSeen.message: Not seen on any game page yet. Open the game, then come back here.

browsePerm.message: To browse and download addons, allow access to GitHub (and GitLab for a few). The extension only downloads public files and sends nothing about you.

catalogOffline.message: Could not reach the list. Showing the saved copy from {time}. {count} addons.

catalogError.message: Could not load the addon list. Check your connection and tap Refresh list.

installedFrom.message: Installed {name}. It is off by default: turn it on in My addons, then reload the game.

noZipRelease.message: This release has no ZIP file to install. Use the Source button to get it by hand.

loadedInGame.message: The game requested files for this addon (injection verified).

loadOnDemand.message: Load-on-demand addon: the game loads it only when another addon requests it.

dependencyCycle.message: Circular dependency detected. Load order may be unreliable.

sameVersionAlready.message: Already have this addon at the same or a newer version, or its version cannot be verified: {names}. Kept the existing copy.

installedSomeSkipped.message: Installed {name}. Skipped same-version copies already in your library: {names}.

managementHint.message: Live Game Scan checks addon files requested by the running game. Prepared addons are not counted as loaded until the game actually requests their files. Backups include addon files, not SavedVariables or game settings.

scanFound.message: Scan complete. Imported {count} addon(s); skipped {skipped} already present.

scanEmpty.message: No valid 3.3.5a addon folders were found. Select the Interface/AddOns folder, not the Interface folder.

updateNone.message: All installed addons are current, or no newer compatible releases were found.

sourcePriority.message: Newest compatible version is preferred. You can select another source.

copyErrorsFailed.message: Could not copy the error log. Select and copy the text manually.

updateDoneWithFailures.message: Updated {count} addon(s), but {failed} update(s) failed. See the error log.

scanWaiting.message: No live game scan data yet. Open or reload Lasthavens and wait for the game to request addon files.

liveScanDone.message: Live scan: {loaded} addon(s) requested by the game, {prepared} prepared, {failed} failed.

preparedForGame.message: Prepared for injection; the game has not requested its files yet.

removeAddonPrompt.message: Remove {name} from this browser’s addon library?

backupBeforeRemove.message: Download a ZIP backup before removing

settingsPreservedNote.message: The addon files will be removed. Game-side addon settings are not touched and may be available again if you reinstall the addon.
